_readme: SCRIPTS THAT WRITE data_audit_log WITH COLUMNS IT DOES NOT HAVE.
Every file here inserts a key that is not a column, or omits a NOT NULL one.
PostgREST answers PGRST204 and the caller almost always swallows it, so the
write reports success and never happens. Recorded 2026-09-06: of 1,092,446
rows in that table, not one came from any of these scripts.
A RATCHET. A pull request may not ADD a file here. When you fix one, DELETE
its line in the same commit - the check fails on a stale entry too, so the
list cannot rot in either direction.
THE FIX IS THE SAME EVERY TIME: keep table_name, record_id, action, batch_id,
agent_id, created_at at the top level, and move everything else into
new_data, which is jsonb and accepts anything.
